QuantsMind-LLM
==============

India's own from-scratch sovereign LLM — multimodal (image <-> text) model family,
finance as first vertical.

Published from ``docs/source`` RST via GitHub Pages on every ``main`` merge.
Rule book: ``docs/RULEBOOK.md``. Owner / sole contributor: ``ajit-ai``.

.. toctree::
   :maxdepth: 2
   :caption: Multimodal (M1)

   mm_m1

.. note::

   **M1 is not promoted.** M1.1 establishes synthetic multimodal architecture and
   optimization evidence only. See :ref:`mm-m1-status`.

Documentation source lives under ``docs/source`` (Sphinx-RST). Platform decisions and
the execution tracker live in the Markdown docs at the repository root (``docs/*.md``).
